name: Population Estimates Program (PEP) county, state and national totals and components of change, Vintage 2025 (CO-EST2025-ALLDATA, NST-EST2025-ALLDATA)
description: Annual July 1 resident population estimates 2020-2025, the April 1 2020 estimates base, and components of change (births, deaths, natural change, international, domestic and net migration, residual, group quarters) with rates per 1,000 for nation, regions, divisions, states and counties.
access_requirements: None (keyless HTTPS). CSV is Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1), not UTF-8; STATE/COUNTY are zero-padded text codes; SUMLEV 040 state and 050 county rows in the county file; NST file adds 010 nation, 020 region, 030 division.
time_coverage: 4/1/2020 estimates base; 7/1/2020-7/1/2025 annual estimates; components 4/1/2020-6/30/2025 (Vintage 2025)
update_cadence: Annual vintage (nation/state about December-January; counties about March; V2025 counties released March 2026). Each vintage revises all post-2020 years.
history_notes: Boundaries as of January 1, 2025. Connecticut appears as 9 planning regions (09110-09190) since Vintage 2022 (V2021 used legacy counties 09001-09015). 2010-2019 must come from the 2010-2020 intercensal files and 2000-2009 from the 2000-2010 intercensal files.
suppression_rules: None; totals published for every county.
limitations: Model-based estimates with no published error; never mix vintages; residual component; ESTIMATESBASE2020 differs slightly from 2020 Census counts (e.g., Marion Co. IN 977,202 vs intercensal CENSUS2020POP 977,206).
doc_evidence: Fetched layout PDF (release March 2026): fields SUMLEV to RNETMIG2025; notes say boundaries are 'as of January 1, 2025'.
sample_evidence: Downloaded full CSV (2,071,735 bytes; 51 SUMLEV 040 + 3,144 SUMLEV 050 rows). Marion Co. IN (18097) POPESTIMATE2025 = 992,196; one Latin-1 byte (0xF1).

name: PEP city and town (subcounty) population estimates, Vintage 2025 (SUB-EST2025)
description: Annual July 1 resident population estimates 2020-2025 and April 1 2020 base for incorporated places, minor civil divisions (MCDs), consolidated cities, county-place parts and MCD-place parts, with state and county totals.
access_requirements: None (keyless). Latin-1 encoded. Per-state files are named sub-est2025_{state FIPS without leading zero}.csv (e.g., _1 for Alabama, _18 for Indiana).
history_notes: SUMLEV key: 040 state, 050 county, 061 MCD, 071 MCD place part, 157 county place part, 162 incorporated place, 170 consolidated city, 172 place within consolidated city. All years use January 1, 2025 boundaries; intercensal subcounty files use 2020 and 2010 geography.
limitations: No census designated places (CDPs); 157 and 071 records are parts and must not be summed with 162 totals; place areas change through annexation between vintages; Latin-1 names (e.g., La Canada Flintridge).
doc_evidence: Fetched SUB-EST2025.pdf (release May 2026): field list, SUMLEV key 040/050/061/071/157/162/170/172, boundaries 'as of January 1, 2025'.

name: PEP county population by age, sex, race and Hispanic origin, Vintage 2025 (CC-EST2025)
description: Annual county estimates by 5-year age group, sex, race (alone and alone-or-in-combination) and Hispanic origin (ALLDATA); AGESEX files give broad age groups and median age; SYASEX files give single years of age.
access_requirements: None (keyless). National ALLDATA file is 105 MB; per-state files cc-est2025-alldata-{ss}.csv and cc-est2025-agesex-{ss}.csv use 2-digit state FIPS.
history_notes: AGEGRP 0 = total, 1-18 = 0-4 ... 85+. Race follows 1997 OMB standards with Some Other Race responses modified, so race counts differ from 2020 Census tables. Same layout in 2010-2020 intercensal CC-EST2020INT files (YEAR 1-12); 2000-2010 files differ (AGEGRP 99 = total).
limitations: Modeled, no error measures; race detail for small counties is imputed-heavy; not directly comparable to ACS or Census race tables that include Some Other Race.
doc_evidence: Fetched CC-EST2025-ALLDATA.pdf (release June 2026): YEAR 1=4/1/2020 base, 2-7=7/1/2020-2025; AGEGRP 0=Total, 1-18 five-year groups; SUMLEV 050.

name: American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates, Detailed Tables
description: Survey-based 60-month period estimates with 90% margins of error for small geographies: housing stock, tenure, vacancy, year built, rents, values and cost burden (B25), age and sex, race and Hispanic origin, nativity, mobility, households, language and veteran status.
access_requirements: Census API key required for data queries; variable metadata endpoints (e.g., /data/2024/acs/acs5/variables/B25034_002E.json) answered without a key. Table-based Summary File is a keyless bulk alternative.
history_notes: Legal areas use boundaries as of January 1 of the final year; tracts/BGs 2020-based from 2016-2020; ZCTAs 2020-based from 2021; CBSAs July 2023 from 2023; CT planning regions from 2018-2022; Chugach/Copper River first in 2016-2020 (2015-2019 still 02261); Bedford city 51515 last in 2009-2013. Race question/coding changed 2020.
suppression_rules: Special values: -666666666 estimate not computable; -999999999 (N) too few sample cases; -888888888 (X) not applicable; MOE -222222222 (**), -333333333 (*** open-ended median), -555555555 (***** controlled, MOE zero).
limitations: Sampling error; compare non-overlapping periods; bins change over time (B25034, B25063, B25075, C16001); dollar values in final-year dollars for rent and owner costs; block group availability varies by table.
doc_evidence: Fetched ACS 5-year API page: years 2009-2024; detailed tables down to block group; states all data queries now require an API key.
sample_evidence: Census API requires a key; verified by project adapter

name: Building Permits Survey (BPS): new privately-owned residential construction authorized
description: Buildings, housing units and construction valuation authorized by building permits for new privately-owned residential buildings by structure size (1, 2, 3-4, 5+ units), for permit-issuing places, counties, CBSAs, states and the nation; 'estimates with imputation' and 'reported only' versions.
access_requirements: None (keyless). Comma-delimited text with two header lines and a blank third line; place files split into four Census regions; names space-padded (county names truncated to 30 characters).
time_coverage: County annual 1990-2025 (co1990a.txt-co2025a.txt); county monthly current/YTD files 2000-01 to 2026-08; place annual 1980-2025 by region (e.g., mw1980a.txt-mw2025a.txt)
update_cadence: Monthly (current-month and year-to-date files) and annual (May)
history_notes: Universe about 20,100 permit places January 2014-December 2022; annually updated universe from January 2023 (about 19,900). Place layout eras: 1980-1998 (YY99 date, no FIPS place), 1999-2002, 2003, 2004-2006, 2007+ (FIPS place and FIPS MCD). County files use CT planning regions from 2023 (2022 file uses legacy counties).
suppression_rules: No suppression; nonrespondents imputed in the 'estimates with imputation' columns; 'reported only' columns exclude imputation.
limitations: Permits authorized, not starts or completions; areas not requiring permits excluded (under 1% of units nationally, varies by state); valuation is construction cost; county file lists only counties with permit offices (3,029 in 2025).
doc_evidence: Fetched placeasc.pdf and cntyasc.pdf (Feb 2022) record layouts and BPS methodology page (universe about 20,100 places to 2022; annual universe from 2023).
sample_evidence: Downloaded co2025a.txt (3,029 county rows) and 4 regional 2025 place files (20,070 permit offices). Marion Co. IN 2025: 1,342 units (1-unit 1,041; 5+ 285).

suppression_rules: Index not reported until sample is sufficient; missing values are blank in current files (notes mention '.'); 1990/2000-based columns blank if the base year is missing.
limitations: Developmental indexes; only conforming Enterprise-backed loans; nominal dollars; index levels are not comparable across areas (compare growth only).
